about_text1: The Baza Trainee Ukraine initiative as an educational and training platform arises in response to a public demand that arose in Ukraine in 2022-2023 in the field of employment in the field of information technologies and is a website that unites, as users, two social groups.
about_text2: Ukrainians who master specialties in the field of IT regardless of age and experience — trainees, juniors, sweaters, mentors on the one hand, and communities and communities of Ukraine in the field of charity, volunteering, and public initiatives on the other.
about_text3: Combine these categories in a joint activity in such a way that both parties benefit. For the first group, it is a real practical experience of creating a live project, for the second, it is a digital product that works and contributes to the development of a social initiative.
about_text4: Train the participant based on the technologies they currently possess and facilitate their employment. When creating a project, apply the technologies that the participant wants to develop, there is no retraining. To provide the customer with a high-quality digital product.
